summary: Jindal Steel received a demand for excess ITC of ₹8.41 crore and equal penalty for June 2020-March 2022. The company deems the impact immaterial and plans to appeal.

summary: Aegis Logistics reported record H1FY27 profit after tax of ₹866 crore, up 108% YoY. Gas division EBITDA surged 137%, while the company announced a $809 million acquisition of Tristar Holdings.
